referenceImages.name: Jean-Noël Desmarais Pavilion
referenceImages.scope: Jean-Noël Desmarais Pavilion at 1380 Sherbrooke Street West. The standing exterior includes the named two-era main frontage and contiguous low museum connector.

review.notes: Qualla images were screened first. Its exact Hornstein original refers to the 1912 pavilion, and the Inuit gallery photo shows interior exhibits. The Bourgie local rendition did not match the photographer’s original file. No museum or architects’ images were imported as appearance sources. The independent model uses the mapped pavilion and primary architectural prose only.
